column1: # Role of each geometry-engine source module (ge.u line table, IRIX 6.5.30m), one line each, written by hand
# from the module's labels and from what reaches them (ucode/ge_xref.tsv). All INFERRED unless ge_handlers.md says otherwise.

column2: role
program entry at address 0 (`HereWeGo`): every even geif.u entry and the 60 unused odd entries point here, and 31 handlers end by jumping to it (ucode/ge_ops.md)
start-up initialisation of engine memories and registers (`MemRegInit`), reached from the entry code
block load of coefficient memory (CRAM) from the input stream
block clear of external memory (ERAM)
pixel-path lookup-table stage (16-bit and RGBA alpha-only forms), added by the ARM's AddLuminanceLut
antialiased-line response tables (maximum, step, response), used by the line-width and AA table code
pixel-path stage expanding bitmap bits to floats, LSB-first and MSB-first loops
pixel-path stage expanding bitmap bits to integers, LSB-first and MSB-first loops
pixel-path clamp stage, added by AddClamp
clear commands: colour, index, depth, accumulation and overlay clears, sent by arm_clear and its helpers
triangle and polygon clipping against the user planes and the view frustum
colour-table and pixel-map lookup stages and their upload and download
general 3x3 convolution pixel stage
general 5x5 convolution pixel stage
general 7x7 convolution pixel stage
context save (deactivate and mop-up): engine state written out section by section for the ARM's deactivate code
context load and destroy: registers, flag registers, WRAM, ERAM, CRAM and the input FIFO restored, and reload from the BEF shadow
debug monitor: number printing, drain, roll call and the slop command
deformation map loading and the deformation query
line primitive output: plain, stippled, multisample and line-list forms
multisample point output with distance attenuation and the sample tables
point primitive output: plain, antialiased, multisample and distance-attenuated
triangle output with polygon offset
vertex-entry points the distributor jumps to: raster position, points and the line-strip vertex save and copy forms
GL error codes recorded on the engine (invalid enum, value, operation, stack overflow and underflow)
evaluator polynomial inner loops of general order in U and V, with derivatives
evaluator polynomial loops of order 1
evaluator polynomial loops of order 2
evaluator polynomial loops of order 4
evaluator change of basis for orders 1-8
evaluator state save, load and swap for 1D and 2D maps
pixel-path component expansion (RGB, LA, CI, single component), added by AddExpand2RGBA
feedback mode: begin and end, and the point, line, triangle and pixel feedback records
FFT pixel path (sizes 2 to 256), transpose and complex output, set up by SetupGE_FFT
pixel-path float-to-integer stage, added by AddF2I
geometry pipeline control: module dirty flags, multipass, punt and the vertex save and copy helpers
fog: global table set-up, fog function, mode, enable and offset
start-up and context initialisation of GL and X state, pipe set-up
general (multi-light, local viewer) lighting loop
local and infinite light-source terms of the general lighting
query replies: current values, raster position and special registers
light and material queries, and the push and pop of light attributes
polygon-offset commands (core and extension)
raster and pipeline modes: viewport, depth range, cull face, front face, matrix mode, point parameters, sprites, multipass, the IrisGL lighting flag
histogram and min-max state moved between ERAM and CRAM, and the ERAM fill
pixel-path histogram stage, added by AddHistogram
engine-to-host returns: read-data framing, ERAM, CRAM, special-register and last-vertex output DMA
colour-index and IrisGL lighting final stages
pixel-path integer-to-float stage, added by AddInt2Float
lighting, light-source and colour-material enables and disables, spot power table recompute
light-model parameters (ambient, local viewer, two-sided) and colour-material face selection
per-light parameters: position, spot direction, exponent and cutoff, attenuation, colours
lighting initialisation and the dirty-state refresh of the lighting tables
line clipping against the user planes and the view frustum
line width, stipple and antialiased-line tables
GL context swap in and out on the engines, end of a pixel stream
pixel-path mask stage
material parameters and their updates
scalar math subroutines: reciprocal, square root, reciprocal square root
matrix copy, transpose, identity, ortho and frustum helpers
matrix stack commands per matrix mode: push, pop, load, multiply, rotate, scale, translate, frustum, ortho
pixel-path colour-matrix stage, added by AddColorMatrix
pixel-path component-order reversal, added by AddCompOrder
primitive decomposition: triangle strips, quads, quad strips, polygons, simple triangles
pixel-path 16-bit depth decompression, added by AddDecompressZ
memory moves between ERAM, WRAM and CRAM
32-bit expansion stages for 1- and 2-component pixels
pixel-path L12A4 extraction, added by AddExtract
pixel-path min-max stage, added by AddMinMax (ucode/ge_ops.md, "Settling the ties")
sine and cosine of two angles
4x4 matrix multiply, CRAM by CRAM into CRAM
memory moves from WRAM to CRAM and to the output FIFO
pixel-path set-up: stream distribution to the next engine, CRAM/ERAM copies, integer-to-float and shift skips
pixel output stages for GL and X: component packing, polygon stipple, transparent and opaque bitmaps
separable convolution stages 3x3, 5x5 and 7x7
short-circuit pixel conversions between packed formats
pixel-path RGB-to-luminance sum, added by AddSumRGB2L
vertex-array unpack for lit vertex formats (V3F with colour, normal and texture coordinates)
Phong-shaded triangle output with per-pixel normalise and light
performance instruments start and stop
point clipping against the user planes and the view frustum
multisample point tables and point size
polygon set-up for render, select and feedback modes, and polygon mode
triangle output in line or point polygon mode
lighting with per-primitive material changes
restore of transform attributes, FFT factor initialisation
raster-board commands: register writes, flush, accumulation, current raster, colour-index and RGBA modes, texture address set-up, clipmap transform
reference-plane commands
pixel-path scale-and-bias stage and the depth final stage
selection mode: begin and end, name stack
selection hit recording per primitive type
pixel-path shift-and-add stage
sprite (SGIX_sprite) rotation modes
patch subdivision entry and tags
texture environment

texture binding, scale and bias, the texture-memory load FIFO and the texture address
colour-matrix inner loop
face culling
primitive decomposition of strips, lines and triangles
simple triangle-strip decomposition
deformation of coordinates and texture coordinates
triangle and quad output
1D evaluator commands: map spec, map data, grid, strip
2D evaluator commands: map spec, map data, grid, strip
evaluator change of basis for geometry, colour, normal and texture maps
evaluator coordinate entry (EvalCoord) for 1D and 2D
simple lighting and colour clamp
sine and cosine
matrix multiply, inverse, adjoint, rotate and scale
memory moves WRAM, CRAM and ERAM in each direction
vertex-array unpack enable and disable, colour and normal restore
pixel colour-stream entry into the engine
packed pixel output loops
transformation to screen space with the second-chance (clipped) path
separable 3x3 convolution row and column loops
separable 5x5 convolution row and column loops, with a fast form
separable 7x7 convolution row and column loops
texture-coordinate generation loops: sphere, eye-linear, object-linear
vertex-array unpack loops for unlit vertex formats
object-to-clip transformation with optional normal-to-eye transformation
video-controller bus writes for the display board (cursor, colour map, gamma, mode, swap)
X server clipped drawing of points, lines and rectangles
X server drawing commands: points, lines, segments, rectangles, boxes, spans
X server state loads: graphics context, position, clip, scissor, pixel set-up
X server set-up of clip, colours and window
